reviews.title: I love this but in the latest update…
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for the longest and I do love it. Never had any complaints. None. Until now. Hence  the reason I took down one star. It might not be a big deal to some, but to me, I used to to this every single day at least. Idk if someone can relate. In the latest update, you are listening to one playlist and when you click the green button to play and it does, but it’s just the continuation of the song you’re listening to. Meaning that, the songs that you’ve already heard say the day before, you won’t listen to them on that day because it doesn’t start from the beginning of the playlist. To do that, you have to go ahead and play another playlist, and then come back to play the desired one again to get it to start all over again. BUT you also have to make sure that you pressed the “shuffled” button bc if not, you’ll hear the songs in the order that they are and have to go back and click it. Whereas before, all you had to do was click on the green round button and it would automatically start from the beginning shuffled and all bc I always had the shuffle button on. In this update, it seems to “turn off” in idk what pattern. Maybe each day? Idk. I have diff. playlists, but most of the time I use the same one and so it’s very much annoying since it’s become more time consuming when all I really want to do is get my music going quickly and do what I gotta do. I’m not sure why they did it like this bc it also had a button to just resume your playlist as well, where you left off. I just hope they go back to the way it was when it comes to that because it’s pretty irritating:/

reviews.title: Flawed, but does the job
reviews.text:
It’s a great app other than two things:

1) If you’re in an area of weak signal or slow wi-fi, the app takes an age to open and go to your album of choice, even when you just want to play something you’ve downloaded and saved to your phone. We’re talking several minutes, even on the latest iPhone. The only way round the problem is to switch to aeroplane mode, go to what you want to hear, them switch off plane mode to switch Bluetooth on to hear the music. I’ve been doing this hack now for years and I don’t think they’ll ever sort it. Annoying. I’ve spoken to support but just get ignored, or mid-understood (they always think I’m trying to stream music).

2) There’s a massive ‘play shuffled’ button on an album’s screen, but no normal ‘play’ button for those of us who want to hear an album with the tracks in the right order. You need to tap on a track to play it, and the next track will follow. BUT! When you do this, the play with shuffle button flips to a big pause button, but if you tap it to unpause, it goes to shuffle mode and immediately changes the track. Terrible GUI design.

reviews.title: Holly Lerski - Sweet Decline
reviews.text: British born, Norwich girl, Holly Lerski has reinvented herself with her 2024 comeback album ‘Sweet Decline’  recorded in Nashville, USA.  If you are a fan of Americana road trip movies or books like Jack Kerouac’s On the Road, or Thelma and Louise, Wild at heart…and if you love the beautiful twang of a guitar- this one’s for you. Highlights are the infectious title track which I have added  to a lot of my own playlists! Yosemite is an incredible  little instrumental that just slides so serenely into the wonderful ‘Tall Trees’ - a beautiful anthem to nature and pining for the return of a lost love. Holly’s own road trip across the States included Carmel in California and Chicago. File under Alt- Americana if you wish but at times there are hints of Tracey Thorn of Everything but the Girl. In fact if Todd Terry were to remix Tall Trees , if Bob Clearmountain, Rhett Davies and Warren Ellis got hokd of Yosemite, or Trevor Horn with Girl in a high Castle, We could see Holly Lerski break into the top 40 or the Billboard hot 100! But, they are beautiful as they are and really worth a listen. CD and downloads available.

reviews.title: Calm down with the long commercials.
reviews.text: I could be wrong, but isn’t it better to hit people with quick, to the point, shots of why we should get the product? The 30 second commercials seem too long; forget about 2 min of hearing about each product. And do ya have to keep repeating the same thing 3 different ways? And that’s if there’s creativity involved; if not it’s just repeat the same words back to back to back to back. So you’re saying we haven’t got any smarter since Biblical times? Back then, making the point repetitively was the best way to get info to stick in our thick skulls. Here’s the truth -that you can only change by distracting me with annoyance at 90 seconds of redundant raving- I will “click here” if I’m truly interested! Which seems like what the goal should always be. Here’s 15 seconds of this great product, wanna know more? Click here to go to the site. And if now isn’t the right time, then “click over here ~tell me later; take me to the site in 20, 30, 50 min etc.” I realize that 25 years ago our entertainment came with over 20% commercial time. No choices, just the way it was   -sit there and wait. And it was too much advert info then. And now we get all this “free” info\entertainment on the interwebs. But it’s somehow even more advert info now! Deflating difference is; it’s now everywhere, all the time, nowhere to look if you don’t want pitch, pitch pitch.

reviews.title: Great content, needs work to make more user friendly
reviews.text:
Great app & content. But a few tweaks would make it more user friendly.
I reeeeally dislike having to click on the dots & 'add to playlist' 4 times for every playlist I want to add a song to. Surely you should be able to hit add to more than one playlist without having to go back through all the menu options again, click the dots again & add to playlist again. Not very streamlined.
Also would love a ‘fast forward’ or ‘rewind’ button like what you have on podcast apps so that you can skip through 15sec at a time instead of trying to scroll to a certain point clumsily with your fingers on a tiny dot. This is particularly hard to do when exercising.
It appears not much has changed with the functionality over the years to improve usability

reviews.title: It keeps stopping
reviews.text:
A problem I frequently have is that when listening to my music, the songs will randomly stop playing and when I go to hit play again, the app restarts. Sometimes admittedly, it’s just because my app needs updated, but it will also do that completely randomly at times. What is with that? I’ll continue playing my music again, and not only will the song restart, but it also cuts off again but even earlier than it did before. It’s honestly extremely annoying and very difficult to deal with when I’m working either at home or at my job. Nine times out of ten, I’d have to close the app completely, and wait thirty to ninety minutes before my music will play uninterrupted again. It’s incredibly frustrating, especially since all I want is to play some music. 

Another thing is six skips per hour? Really? That’s so incredibly annoying, and it makes it worse when I’m wasting all my skips on the stupid suggested tracks you give me. I don’t want to listen to that!? If you absolutely HAVE to put something in, play more of the same artist at least. It’s so annoying to only have six skips and waste them all on music that I never wanted to hear in the first place. The worst part is, even if I go to a different playlist and come back, it continues playing the suggested track. I don’t want it! On that note, I also don’t want the extra songs you put in my playlists. I take one track off, another gets added. If I wanted that song in my playlist, I’d put it there.

Sometimes admittedly, it’s just because my app needs updated, but it will also do that completely randomly at times. What is with that? I’ll continue playing my music again, and not only will the song restart, but it also cuts off again but even earlier than it did before. It’s honestly extremely annoying and very difficult to deal with when I’m working either at home or at my job. Nine times out of ten, I’d have to close the app completely, and wait thirty to ninety minutes before my music will play uninterrupted again. It’s incredibly frustrating, especially since all I want is to play some music. Another thing is six skips per hour? Really? That’s so incredibly annoying, and it makes it worse when I’m wasting all my skips on the stupid suggested tracks you give me. I don’t want to listen to that!? If you absolutely HAVE to put something in, play more of the same artist at least. It’s so annoying to only have six skips and waste them all on music that I never wanted to hear in the first place. The worst part is, even if I go to a different playlist and come back, it continues playing the suggested track. I don’t want it! On that note, I also don’t want the extra songs you put in my playlists. I take one track off, another gets added. If I wanted that song in my playlist, I’d put it there.

reviews.title: Every major update makes the app worse and harder to use
reviews.text:
The recent changes to the podcast element of the app is unbearable. 

Having a separate section for podcasts was so much easier than having it lumped in with the music. I know you can still filter to show only podcast but you still don’t get all the options the previous podcast window gave you. 

I used to be able to look a an entire list of podcasts that I followed. Therefore if I wanted to listen to a really old episode of a podcast - something I do regularly, it was quite easy. Now it’s such a ball ache to do this and requires so much more scrolling. It’s tedious. 

Then there’s the ‘Your Episodes’ playlist which is impossible to delete. Every episode you download automatically ends up on there, yet you have to manually remove each one from the playlist. If this wasn’t annoying enough, you have to do 2 clicks to get rid of a podcast from the playlist instead of one click or a swipe. It may not sound like much but it adds a good couple of seconds to the process. So when you have 200+ eps on the playlist, you have to dedicate an afternoon to clearing it. 

It’s as if you want to make it harder for users to use this app. This is only the second app review I’ve ever written - I usually just accepting the changes and adapt to them. But when you continually make the app worse, it’s hard to not get annoyed. Please revert the podcast section to what it used to be. 

FWIW I also much preferred the old layout of the Artists section too but presumably it’s too late to go back on that now. Please please change podcasts though. This issue has made me seriously consider switching to Apple Music.

reviews.text:

Please bring back the heart button, this new save button just doesn’t work the same. Pretty worthless if you ask me. 

Also, why are non premium users restricted to not see an artist’s playlist/album? 
We already have the *torture* of hundreds of constant, nonstop ads and the wretched shuffle playlists which contain unwanted/recommended songs and a minimum of 6 skips an hour. What’s the point of hiding the contents of an artist’s album? It’s so pointless and infuriating.

Very disappointed

It would be nice if you could search for songs using the lyrics if you don’t know the name of the song.

Despite these faults, I rate it 4 stars.

reviews.title: Useful but definitely needs more improvements
reviews.text:
I like this app very much, but there’s still quite a few easy improvements to be made that will make a huge difference.

1. Adding the ability to change the order of playlists- Not having the ability to change the order of my playlists caused some very annoying issues as I didn’t want my artists playlists mixed up with my genre playlists and so in order to work around this, I had to number each playlist in the order I wanted them in which was rather time consuming. (I am aware it’s possible to change playlist order on desktop but was unaware of this at the time.)

2. Being able to create playlist folders- This would have made it so much easier to sort through my music when placing music into playlists while not having to scroll past all the other playlists as they would have been in folders.  (I am aware that it is possible to do this on desktop but was unaware of that at the time.)

3. Having the ability to select multiple tracks and copy them to another playlist- This was a problem when I organised my music into year playlists and then wanted to copy them to decade playlists. As this was not an available function on the app I had to manually add each one.  (I am aware it’s possible to change playlist order on desktop but was unaware of this at the time.)

Now yes most of my issues can be solved on the desktop version, but having these features on the app would have been a lot easier and more convenient rather than having to log in on a computer to do this.
And without these simple features, it makes it nearly impossible to organise your music effectively while on the go.

reviews.title: It’s been getting worse and not fixed
reviews.text:
My main gripe is that features that used to work (and were very useful/seemingly basic functions) no longer do, and they have yet to have been fixed for more than a year now.

I hope with every update they would, but alas.

My issues:
1. You can’t search within a playlist and have it retain that search once you’ve selected something.

2. Playback within playlists (when not on shuffle) is broken, you can’t listen in linear playback/sort by artist and listen through. It seemingly has linear mode only able to play through by order added, though it’s not even accurate to that either.

3. Offline search, this was my work around to the previous issue, but this doesn’t work now. Offline search only gives you minimal results and you can’t bring up an entire album/artist (even if they’re saved offline) as you once could and play from there. And playback here is also janky, linear only letting you play the one song you select.

It used to be perfect, but too many key features I used (and were essential to the way I liked to listen) don’t work. Having contacted support multiple times asking after these problems I’ve been told they’re being looked at but it’s been over a year and still broken.
So why not fix these things that used to work, before adding new things ?

Additional context in a premium subscriber and have been for at least 6 years. So I still use and like the service, but the mobile app just isn’t as good as it could be - which is sad, as it used to do everything I would want it to.

Everything feels designed in the model of social media now: there’s tiktok-style discovery features and even a messaging feature for some reason. Maybe this app is just teaching me to appreciate the slow internet of the 90’s, but it needs some genuine redesigning. Please get rid of these nonsensical add-ons, or even make a mode where you can only see the bare minimum possible to use it. Using this app makes me crave old MP3 players with 2cm squared of screen.

reviews.title: Suggestions for classical music especially:
reviews.text:
I listen to all sorts of music & this app is great for being able to find your way outside the usual “bubble”. But for people who listen to classical works there are a few issues that could probably be easily improved. 
First is to be able to see who has recorded a particular piece, then choose which soloist/conductor/orchestra/choir etc to download. At the moment there’s little choice, and it’s very difficult to see (at least on my iPhone 6s+ screen) who is featured. 
Second, when I am listening to something with a lot of movements I want to see quickly which one is playing- but the scrolling info is so slow that the screen goes back to sleep before the movement number goes across - or else it’s something like the Rachmaninov variations on a theme of Paganini, with 24 short sections and the movement is finished before its number reaches the screen. Can I set it to scroll faster? Or touch it to pause & enlarge to see all the info at once? 
Third thing is lack of important info like recording date & the other things mentioned above, ho was in he band for this recording etc 
Lastly atm, I haven’t figured out how to just play my playlist and then stop - it goes on to play random stuff and totally spoils the mood. Annoying. 
But overall a good app, worth the money.

reviews.title: Worse and worse
reviews.text:
I’ve been a premium subscriber for nearly 10 years now, and I’ve spent the past 6 months searching for alternatives. 

Every single update now introduces new useless GUI plus bugs that make the app only just tolerable at best and often unbearably frustrating. From the retroactively declared “experiment” of an embarrassing homepage failed rollout to a chorus of disgust, to constant glitches during playback, to downloads disappearing or greyed out when playing offline, to constant full-screen Tik-Tok-esque reel tiles that fill the screen and auto play trash music you have zero interest in (stopping the music you have playing), a support system that tosses you around in a chat room until you give up, zero tech help, a dev team that ignores users, a community page stuffed with angry and disappointed users and condescendingly cheerful moderators ignoring them all, a facade voting system to community suggest new features (that always has the same requests, never implemented), a public history of scalping artists with shamefully little compensation, and an algorithm more inane than the Idiocracy medical exam.

reviews.title: Add a “Play Next” button
reviews.text: I dislike the lack of functionality in the macbook app, compared to the iphone app.  Also why on earth is there not an "add to play next" type button/option, as opposed to merely a "add to queue" option? It is so annoying that when you already have a long queue, you can only add an item to the end of the queue, and the you have to manually move that item all the way up to the beginning of the long queue just because you actually want hear that item *next*. reviews.text:

It’s annoying especially when listening to a long running show. Another thing is ads for podcasts. I’m paying premium so why are we STILL having ads. 

 Better music recommendations.
 At LEAST 80% of the time, Spotifys recommends are songs that I’ve already listened to before and there’s a reason I’ve not added it to a playlist or queue. Usually the song is a very different genre to what I’m looking/asking for or it’s one that ALWAYS shows up in recommendations.

Wrapped 2024 was abysmal. All that waiting for nothing. Previous years have had fun inclusions like where in the world listens like you, what genre you are etc… this year NOTHING. Layouts and slides were boring. No actual insight to my listening year. Just bare minimum. Disappointing as the app has felt bare bones all year with nothing interesting being added. Ai podcast recap was stupid, if that’s what we were waiting for then scrap it immediately.

reviews.title: Where’s the functionality?
reviews.text:
1) I can’t play JUST a playlist or JUST an album. I press play on a playlist or album and the next song doesn’t play on that album!! Why? 
⭐️ MOST NEEDED FEATURE⭐️: 2) I can’t quickly add songs to a playlist. I have to touch the “...” and individually add songs to a playlist rather than being able to select multiple songs to transfer to a playlist. This makes it a pain to create playlists unless you simply add an entire album to a playlist, which is the only way to add multiple songs at one time to a playlist. I noticed that you can do this at the bottom of the playlist after you scroll through your songs, but only for “recommended” music which is great, but it’s random and not mine sometimes. You should be able to scroll through your saved music and click on each song you’d like to add to a specific (or multiple) playlist without having to click “...” first. For example, I hate to compare but Apple Music has a feature where you can click “Playlist”>”Edit”>”Add Music” which then brings you to your library to add music from there OR you can search music to add that you have not yet saved or downloaded.
3) I love the idea of being able to discover new music and whatnot. Thought I’d add at least one good thing to the list. It’s a great app, but until these issues are fixed, I’m keeping it at 3 stars.

Edit: 1st issue resolved with their great tech support team! However, still only 4 stars because I can’t use the mobile app to add multiple songs at one time to a playlist. (This is only a big deal because it takes forever to create a brand new playlist).
